spec: §4.1 measurement draw FIFO, bits-lexicographic outcome ordering and strict CDF boundary
derivation: Each fresh two-wire register receives H on both wires, so its four outcome weights are 1/4 in printed-bit order 00,01,10,11. Draw 1/4 is an exact tie after 00 and selects 01 (value 2); draw 3/4 selects 11 (value 3). Reversing the queue gives values 3,2; sorting outcomes by integer value gives 1,3.
